other_conditions: Agency and its functionaries must be bonafide Indian agencies and Indian citizens.

Applicants may include registered jute entrepreneurs/manufacturers, exporters, merchant traders, NGOs, cooperative societies, federations, PSUs/organizations of central or state government, and other firms engaged in product identification, bulk production, skill training and marketing of Jute Diversified Products for at least the last three years.
Recognized agencies should have at least three years of experience in training, promotion and development of women self‑help groups in jute product production and marketing.
The collaborating agency must have its own office of at least 250 sq ft with telephone/mobile connection, computer/laptop and email facilities, and at least 500 sq ft space for setting up the JRCPC.
benefits_summary: Provides training, design, production, raw material and market support to artisans and women self‑help groups to set up Jute Diversified Product units, creating employment and promoting eco‑friendly jute alternatives.
documents_required: Ownership document (MoU/AoA of Companies/Registered Deed of Partnership/Registration of Societies or Trade License) and Aadhaar Card / Address Proof of the authorized representative of the agency
Income Tax Return for last financial year along with PAN number
Details of PAN, GST returns for the last 3 financial years
Annual Reports for last three financial years
Audited financial statements for last three years
Any other documents establishing the credential of the agency
Other supporting documents (Project experience certificates etc.)
Details of experience in trainings, designing/product development, production and marketing of JDP sector including awards and creativity
Proof of experience and handling relevant activities
Concept/Approach note highlighting the need for quality training and development of JDP sector
Undertaking from the agency that the JRCPC will be operated for at least one year
